design_description: A black-and-gold Aztec-inspired design with a dark marble/cracked-stone pattern running across the entire jersey. Gold detailing on the collar and cuffs gives it a premium finish. The front stays relatively clean with the crest and sponsor, while the back makes the statement with a large detailed Aztec warrior/jaguar graphic rising from the lower section beneath the gold player name and number. Overall, a dark, powerful and premium look, combining stone texture with strong Aztec imagery.
